readout_other: visual choice task (left/right saccade choice), eye tracking
direction_notes: Pulsed stimuli at 10% duty cycle produced an ipsilateral choice bias, read as inhibition; continuous stimuli produced a contralateral bias, read as excitation.
safety_notes: The subject showed no signs of discomfort; discrimination accuracy increased over 39 sessions, taken as behavioural evidence of no harm.

exposures.label: Left and right LGN, 650 kHz, 10%, 50% and 100% duty

target.label: left and right lateral geniculate nucleus

timing.protocol_description: A 300 ms stimulus was delivered 150 ms before fixation point offset, into the left or right LGN every 6-14 s, side randomised, interspersed with no-ultrasound trials. Stimuli were either continuous (100% duty) or pulsed at 10% duty with a 500 Hz PRF; a 50% duty condition is mentioned in the supplement without PRF.

source_quotes.n_subjects: One subject participated in this study (male macaca mulatta, age 6 years, weight 8 kg).
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: We delivered the ultrasound into the deep brain targets repeatedly, over 39 sessions.
source_quotes.exposures[0].free_field.pressure_kpa: Using the same input voltage, the free field pressure–measured using a hydrophone–is 2.4 MPa at the location of the left and right LGN.
source_quotes.exposures[0].in_situ.pressure_kpa: The peak focal pressure (estimated from the thermometry data) was 770 and 650 kPa in the right and left LGN respectively.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_repetition_fre: The pulsed stimulus (10% duty) used a 500 Hz pulse repetition frequency.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.duty_cycle_pct: Relative to sonication of the right LGN, sonication of the left LGN induces a leftward bias for a 10% duty stimulus and a rightward bias for a 50 and 100% duty stimulus.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.sonication_duration_: In an ultrasound trial, a 300 ms stimulus was delivered 150 ms before the fixation point offset.
source_quotes.exposures[0].device.manufacturer: Our custom, 256 element transducer (Doppler Electronic Technologies, Guangzhou, China) can produce focal pressures greater than 3 MPa at its 650 kHz center frequency.
source_quotes.exposures[0].device.model: Our custom, 256 element transducer (Doppler Electronic Technologies, Guangzhou, China) can produce focal pressures greater than 3 MPa at its 650 kHz center frequency.

flags.reason: Pressure at target was estimated from MR thermometry (heating of the focus), recorded here as method measurement. The figure legend gives 750 kPa; the Methods give 770 kPa (right LGN) and 650 kPa (left LGN).
Hydrophone free-field pressure at the same input voltage; the paper does not state whether the waveform was pulsed or continuous for this measurement.
50% duty appears only in the supplementary figure legend; PRF and pulse duration are stated only for the 10% condition.
Not stated; the paper gives only duty cycle and PRF.
No auditory control was run; the authors argue from the left/right and waveform specificity of the effect that an auditory artefact is unlikely.
Trials without ultrasound were randomly interspersed within sessions; there was no separate sham arm.
Custom transducer credited to Doppler Electronic Technologies; driven by a Verasonics system (named in the Software section).
